items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
items.claim: Stretching a rod toward heaven causes thunder, hail, and fire to occur
items.action: stretched rod toward heaven; sent thunder and hail; rained hail
items.mechanism: Rod-elevation triggering meteorological phenomena (thunder, hail, ground fire)
